title: Static Heavy-Haunch Paddle-Tail Beaver
description: One complete newly authored stylised static beaver-like animal in a low crouched four-foot pose. Its broad high rounded rear haunch transitions into a lower thick short neck and blunt cheeked forward head with small round ears. Two short forelegs and two large bent hind legs end in finite whole feet; a very broad flattened oval tail extends backward through a narrow real root. Two distinct thick front incisors emerge below a short dark nose, not a platypus bill. Whole sections, limb paths and tail are newly authored, not an old squirrel tail swap or platypus bill replacement. One static model, zero scenes.
